messages.subject: newbie question - stuck on server code
parts:
I am trying to create a very simple chart of stock chart versus rate (not a time series yet).  When a user inputs a symbol it should return a rate.  Here is a saaple header of my data (locate) and my ui and server code is below.  I think I am stuck with the server code and how to implement symbol as an input parameter.  
Thanks in advance for the help.  




> head(locate)
  Symbol                    Name Inventory  Rate X
1   AAON            AAON INC NEW   3145970 -0.12 R
2    AIR                AAR CORP  11326419 -0.12 

ui.R

library(shiny)

# Define UI for miles per gallon application
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  
  # Application title
  headerPanel("Stock"),
  
  sidebarPanel(
    textInput("symbol", "Symbol", ""),
    
    submitButton(text="Submit")),
  
  mainPanel(
    plotOutput("ratePlot")),
    
))

server.R

library(shiny)

locate <- read.csv("locate.csv")


shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  output$ratePlot <- renderPlot({
    barplot(locate$Rate)
    
  })
  
})

Try this:

output$ratePlot <- renderPlot({
  data <- locate[locate$Symbol == input$symbol,]
  if (nrow(data) == 0)
    NULL
  else
    barplot(data$Rate)
})
